headline: Axios reported that 50-plus leaders across government, AI and cyber unanimously expect worsening cyberattacks on critical infrastructure through 2027, as major US banks banned third-party AI agents and experts warned more major tech outages are coming.

points.text: Axios reported that more than 50 leaders across government, AI, business and cyber were unanimous that cyberattacks on businesses and critical infrastructure will worsen through 2027.
ChinaTalk examined AI's role in enforcing China's Ethnic Unity Law.
Major US banks are banning third-party AI agents from logging into customer accounts, warning that any costly bot mistakes are the customer's problem.
The Verge reported that experts expect more major tech outages, following a nationwide FAA ground stop, a multi-day Outlook outage, and a banking outage at JPMorgan Chase.
